banner.tagline:
The sun was eaten an age ago.
Wake in the ash. Fell the Gatekeeper. Relight the world.

card-threshold.title:
Wake in the
Threshold
bullets: Every new Ashborn wakes in a ruined crypt, floating in its own dimension at dusk
Walk the Hall of Messages toward the black sun
Cross the fog gate and face Ser Odric, Gatekeeper of the Threshold
Fell him, or fall to him once, and the Ember Door opens

card-story.title:
Told in
380 quests
bullets: A prologue, five acts and an epilogue; every act ends on a Sovereign
The Keeper narrates the main story and the old tales
Lore in every chapter, and a secret the Keeper has kept since before the eclipse
Old names for every land: the Grey Wood, the Rime Veil, the Ashlands

card-sovereigns.title:
Eight
Sovereigns
bullets: Seven broke the sun; the Eighth drank its last light
Call each Sovereign with a sigil and fight them in soulslike duels
Every first kill rekindles an ember on the world's Long Eclipse bar
Each ember gives every player a permanent extra heart

card-remnants.title:
The Dead
Rise Ranked
bullets: Mobs rise as Veterans, Elites, Champions and rare named Remnants
On a Hunter's Moon they hunt you: higher levels, more ranks, better spoils
Die, and an Echo of you rises where you fell, guarding your runes
Big bosses from Cataclysm, Mowzie's Mobs and more, woven into the quests

card-soulslike.title:
Runes &
Shrines
bullets: Pick an origin, then grow by runes at Ember Shrines (Runeborn)
Stamina, a dodge roll, flasks, weapon arts and over 70 armaments
RPG levels and attributes, a skill tree and elemental powers
Hire sellswords of the Ashen Company to fight beside you

card-world.title:
A World
Under Ash
bullets: An eclipsed sun, the Ashen 16x look and Fresh Animations by default
Terralith and Tectonic terrain, YUNG's structures, When Dungeons Arise and Much More Dungeons
Reactive music, deeper fog, ambient sound and subtle effects
In Act V, cross into the Eclipsed Realm and its Hollow Sovereign

trailer.title: Watch the Trailer
trailer.sub: One minute, every shot recorded in game inside the pack
